blocks.text: Parols light up homes, familiar holiday treats fill the table, and gatherings call for something special to wear. Across these traditions lies a shared appreciation for things that make Christmas undeniably Filipino, from the family traditions passed down through generations to the artistry woven into what we wear. In line with this spirit, Kultura kicked off Paskong Kumukutikutitap with the launch of Kultura Atelier, the new Filipino Luxury, in SM Makati. Amidst cascading parols, the new expanded store carries collections in collaboration with local designers, in a space where artisanal craft meets elevated design.
